text:
Alex Rivera
Full Stack Software Engineer
Auckland, New Zealand
021 555 0142 | alex.rivera@inspectcopilot.com
SUMMARY
Full-stack engineer with four years building React, Next.js and Node.js products end to end. I care about fast,
accessible interfaces, typed APIs and tests that catch regressions before customers do.
EXPERIENCE
Software Engineer, Humongous Insurance Auckland | Feb 2023 to present
- Rebuilt the customer claims portal in Next.js and React, cutting page load from 4.1 to 1.3 seconds.
- Designed typed REST APIs in Node.js and PostgreSQL for the portal and two partner integrations.
- Moved four Node.js services to AWS Lambda with GitHub Actions deployments.
- Mentor two graduate developers.
Junior Full Stack Developer, Margie's Travel Wellington | Jan 2021 to Jan 2023
- Built booking and itinerary features in React, Next.js and PostgreSQL used by 30,000 customers a month.
- Added Vitest and Playwright tests to a codebase that had none, catching release regressions before customers
did.
- Made the booking flow pass WCAG 2.1 AA.
PROJECTS
- Recipe planner (side project): retrieval over 5,000 recipes with Next.js, PostgreSQL and pgvector, with an LLM
that explains each suggestion.
SKILLS
- Frontend: React, Next.js, TypeScript, accessible HTML and CSS, design systems
- Backend: Node.js, REST APIs, PostgreSQL, Python
- Testing: Vitest, Playwright, contract tests
- Cloud: AWS Lambda and S3, Cloudflare Workers, GitHub Actions
EDUCATION
Bachelor of Computer Science, Te Awa University, 2020
